purpose: Deliver one validated typed effective-forcing vector to the existing PPA-WU01 production owner from decoded PMdirect/SWINTER=0 records without creating a second state, transaction, mass or restart owner.

adapter_may_do: validate one decoded source record per tile
require one source record to cover the requested generic interval
produce a complete immutable effective-forcing vector only when every required process input has an admitted owner route before the owner call

atomicity: Any tile validation or composition failure rejects the entire adapter request before run_standalone_with_forcing is called. A successful request calls that owner exactly once for the requested interval and all tiles.

forcing_semantics.profile: PPA-WU01 standalone Reference Richards bottom_mode=7 only
forcing_semantics.meteorology: immutable decoded daily B1 MOD_meteo fields with explicit source provenance and coverage
forcing_semantics.top: existing dynamic-top owner receives PMdirect net rain and existing demand bindings
forcing_semantics.root: restricted prescribed-root route: PPA-WU01 standalone bottom_mode=7 with root_extraction_active and concrete B1.10 root-sink provider only; PMdirect interval transpiration is distributed by the validated cumulative root fractions

remaining_owner_qualification: all-tile composition failure leaves committed revisions unchanged
successful composition uses the existing production owner once and advances each committed revision once
hard mass closure is reported by the existing owner result
two covered generic subdaily intervals preserve owner/restart semantics
no parser/cursor/date or second persistent-state surface
qualified_builder_evidence: src/adapter/mod_ppa_atm02_pmdirect_production_forcing_adapter.f90: all tile-local meteorology, PMdirect/SWINTER=0, surface demand, dynamic-top and prescribed-root routes fail closed before forcing is returned
tests/fapp/test_ppa_atm02_pmdirect_production_forcing_adapter.f90: O0 and O2 composition, root materialization and invalid-root rejection pass
src/runtime/mod_fmr_production_application_bootstrap.f90: restricted standalone bottom_mode=7 root-enabled profile is admitted
next_safe_step: Use the qualified builder to form every tile forcing before one run_standalone_with_forcing owner call, and qualify commit, mass and restart behavior over two covered intervals.
required_postimage: no mutation of Reference Richards, transaction, restart or mass-ledger implementations
